production_container_verification.diagnosis: Production container environment variable POLYGON_API_KEY is truncated to 23 characters (missing trailing 9 characters of standard 32-character key). Returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

local_authorized_verification.finding: Valid 32-character Polygon key operates normally and returns full consolidated volume.

historical_completed_sessions_sip.finding: Alpaca Basic / Free Tier permits historical consolidated SIP daily bars on completed trading sessions (end <= T-1, 2026-10-19). Query returns 276 daily bars across both 60-bar builder and 260-bar benchmark windows.

current_session_sip.detail: {"message":"subscription does not permit querying recent SIP data"}
current_session_sip.finding: Querying current/real-time session (>= 2026-10-20) requires paid SIP subscription. HTTP 403 occurs only when request window includes current/real-time session.

volume_coverage_comparison_2026_10_19.finding: IEX participant volume represents ~2.78% of consolidated tape volume. Under Selection Rule L04, consolidated 20-day dollar volume (>= $2.0M) is mandatory. IEX volume cannot be substituted for consolidated volume.

polygon.action_required: Update production container POLYGON_API_KEY secret to full 32-character key.

alpaca.iex_limitation: IEX covers only ~2.78% of volume, violating Rule L04 consolidated turnover requirement.
